about: Grammar / punctuation / capitalisation eval set for the English cleanup (scripts/eval_grammar.py). Each case: 'raw' is a hand-written unpunctuated lowercase transcript (the hard case), 'asr' is what Parakeet TDT 0.6b v3 wrote for the same words spoken by a Windows voice (frozen by scripts/eval_grammar.py --freeze-asr; empty = not frozen, e.g. homophones that TTS cannot express), 'expect' lists the acceptable outputs with smart formatting on and no tone.
